sql_schemas: table leave_type | fields: id, name, description, is_paid, requires_approval, max_consecutive_days, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: name: unique lookup by leave type name for validation and policy resolution

table leave_policy | fields: id, leave_type_id, name, accrual_rate_days_per_month, max_balance_days, min_tenure_months, requires_document, effective_from, effective_until, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_type.id | indexes: leave_type_id: policy lookups by leave type; effective_from, effective_until: range queries for active policy resolution

table leave_balance | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, balance_days, accrued_days, used_days, year, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id | indexes: employee_id, leave_type_id, year: composite unique lookup for balance queries per employee per type per year; employee_id: balance summary queries for a single employee across all types

table leave_request | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, status, start_date, end_date, total_days, reason, manager_id, reviewed_at, rejection_reason, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id; manager_id -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id: employee self-service — 'my requests' listing; manager_id: manager approval queue — pending requests for a manager; status: filtering by status (pending/approved/rejected); start_date, end_date: calendar views and date-range overlap checks; leave_type_id: filtering requests by leave type

table audit_log | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, changes, created_at | pk: id | fks: actor_id -> employee.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: audit trail lookups for a specific entity; actor_id: audit trail lookups by actor; created_at: time-range audit queries
